description.purpose: The apply tool: the SECOND tool call of the same requester. It carries the manifest and its digest back out of this hive, verbatim, under the caller's own identity -- which is why the builder never needs an edge to the mutation door.
description.use_when: Behind the tools door, on hop.tool_name == 'apply_manifest'.
description.not_in_scope: No re-rendering, no re-ordering, no re-serialising: any of those changes the bytes, and the submitter would refuse its own colony's draft. And no application -- this cell only carries.
